title: The remote scene tree viewer's horizontal scroll bar does not scroll as far as expected
body: ### Tested versions The bug appears to have been introduced for both the local and remote scene tree viewer in version 4.3.dev6. with the local scene tree viewer being fixed in version 4.4.dev2, and the remote scene tree viewer has remained broken since then. I could not find any relevant merges or issues that relate to this directly, however i may be searching for the wrong thing. versions tested: v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f] issue present v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] issue present v4.5.stable.official [876b29033] issue present v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] issue present v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee] issue present v4.4.dev2.official [97ef3c837] issue is fixed in local viewer but not remote viewer v4.4.dev1.official [28a72fa43] had the issue in both local and remote viewer v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8] had the issue in both local and remote viewer v4.3.dev6.official [89850d553] issue introduced in both scene viewers v4.3.dev5.official [89f70e98d] issue not present v4.3.dev3.official [36e943b6b] issue not present v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3] issue not present v4.2.stable.official [46dc27791] issue not present v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad] issue not present ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8157) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900 (32 threads) - 31.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description In the remote scene tree viewer the horizontal scroll bar does not scale correctly, this makes sufficiently nested nodes difficult to interact with without widening the scene window. The scroll bar in the remote viewer seems to only account for the node icon width and ignores the name box. I’m assuming this behaviour is not intended as the local scene viewer accounts for the name correctly, and the two viewers used to both function how the local one functions now. this is what it looks like currently in 4.7 stable, scrolled as far right as it goes. the nodes name is cut off in the remote viewer this is how it looked in 4.2, all nodes are fully shown here ### Steps to reproduce add nested nodes and or resize the scene tree viewer until you need to scroll to read the node names. when running the project the remote scene tree should have different behaviour to the local scene tree and will not scroll far enough to reveal the names of the nodes, only the icons. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
